title: Bronze Savings Account: Complete Guide
summary: This document explains the Bronze Savings Account’s key terms: 2.0% APY interest, $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, and $0 minimum opening deposit. It covers how to open/fund the account (add funds immediately after opening) and when interest accrues automatically.
